import sys, time, io, http.client, re
sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from urllib3.connection import _normalize_header_value as nv, _normalize_header_values as nvs, _OBSOLETE_FOLD_RE as R

def parse(raw):
    return http.client.parse_headers(io.BytesIO(raw))

cases = {
 "crlf fold": b"X: a\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare LF fold": b"X: a\n b\n\r\n",
 "mixed: LF then CRLF": b"X: a\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare CR inside": b"X: a\r b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare CR no ws": b"X: a\rb\r\n\r\n",
 "empty first line": b"X:\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "trailing ws-only cont": b"X: a\r\n \r\nY: 1\r\n\r\n",
 "VT/FF": b"X: a\x0b b\x0c c\r\n\r\n",
 "x85/x1c": b"X: a\x85 b\x1c c\r\n\r\n",
 "crlf + LF folds": b"X: a\r\n b\n c\r\n\r\n",
}
for k, raw in cases.items():
    try:
        m = parse(raw)
        before = m.items()
        after = nvs(m)
        print(f"{k:24} before={before!r}\n{'':24} after ={after!r} msg={m.items()!r}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(k, "EXC", type(e).__name__, e)

print("--- timing")
for n in (20000, 40000, 80000, 160000):
    for label, v in (
        ("ws run no crlf + fold", "a\r\n b" + " " * n + "x"),
        ("many short ws runs", "a\r\n b" + " x" * n),
        ("ws then CR only", "a\r\n b" + (" " * 50 + "\r") * (n // 50)),
        ("crlf no ws after", "a\r\n b" + " " * n + "\r\nx"),
    ):
        t = time.perf_counter(); nv(v); d = time.perf_counter() - t
        print(f"{n:7} {label:24} {d*1000:8.2f} ms")
# naive pattern for comparison
N = re.compile(r"[ \t]*\r\n[ \t]+")
for n in (20000, 40000):
    v = "a\r\n b" + " " * n + "x"
    t = time.perf_counter(); N.sub(" ", v); print("naive", n, f"{(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000:.1f} ms")
EOF
python3 /tmp/obsfold_probe.py

import sys, io, time, http.client, email.parser
sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from urllib3.connection import _normalize_header_values, _normalize_header_value, _OBSOLETE_FOLD_RE
from urllib3._collections import HTTPHeaderDict

def parse(raw):
    return http.client.parse_headers(io.BytesIO(raw))

cases = {
 "crlf fold": b"X: a\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare LF fold": b"X: a\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare LF fold tab": b"Set-Cookie: a=1\n\tb=2\n\r\n",
 "ows + LF fold": b"X: a \n b\r\n\r\n",
 "fold at start": b"X:\r\n value\r\n\r\n",
 "fold at start sp": b"X: \r\n value\r\n\r\n",
 "trailing ws-only continuation": b"X: a\r\n \r\nY: b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare CR": b"X: a\r b\r\nY: c\r\n\r\n",
 "mixed": b"X: a\r\n b\n c\r\n\r\n",
}
for k, raw in cases.items():
    m = parse(raw)
    before = m.items()
    after = _normalize_header_values(m)
    d = HTTPHeaderDict(after)
    print(f"{k:32} before={before!r}\n{'':32} after ={after!r} msg={m.items()!r} defects={m.defects}")

# timing
for n in (10_000, 20_000, 40_000, 80_000):
    for label, v in (("ws-run then fold", "a" + " " * n + "x\r\n b"),
                     ("many short ws", ("a " * n) + "\r\n b"),
                     ("ws runs no crlf after", ("a" + " " * 50) * (n // 50) + "\r\n b"),
                     ("many lone CRLF", "a\r\n" * n + " b"),
                     ("fold then long ws", "a\r\n" + " " * n + "b")):
        t = time.perf_counter(); _normalize_header_value(v); dt = time.perf_counter() - t
        print(f"n={n:6} {label:24} {dt*1000:8.2f} ms")

# many headers, one folded: cost of del loop
for n in (1000, 2000, 4000, 8000):
    raw = b"".join(b"H%d: v\r\n" % i for i in range(n)) + b"F: a\r\n b\r\n\r\n"
    http.client._MAXHEADERS = 10**6
    m = parse(raw)
    t = time.perf_counter(); _normalize_header_values(m); dt = time.perf_counter() - t
    print(f"headers={n:5} rewrite {dt*1000:8.2f} ms")
for n in (1000, 2000, 4000, 8000):
    raw = b"".join(b"Set-Cookie: c%d=v\r\n" % i for i in range(n)) + b"F: a\r\n b\r\n\r\n"
    m = parse(raw)
    t = time.perf_counter(); _normalize_header_values(m); dt = time.perf_counter() - t
    print(f"same-name headers={n:5} rewrite {dt*1000:8.2f} ms")
EOF
